boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named Santa Cruz destinations on practical downtown and waterfront corridors from UC Santa Cruz, each with a documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Browse with a bookseller
cards.subtitle: Pacific Avenue corridor — 1520 Pacific Ave
cards.notes: On the Pacific Avenue corridor, stop in to browse the shelves or ask a bookseller for help; confirm the posted schedule before making a special trip.
cards.short_summary: An independent bookstore directly on Pacific Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Bookshop Santa Cruz lists its store at 1520 Pacific Avenue and provides business hours.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists daily hours, with Thursday closed.

cards.title: Pause at the clock tower
cards.subtitle: North Pacific Avenue corridor — at Water Street
cards.notes: Use this North Pacific Avenue landmark as a clear meeting point, then continue toward downtown on foot; stay aware of traffic at the busy junction.
cards.short_summary: A city-documented clock tower at North Pacific Avenue and Water Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Santa Cruz identifies the clock tower as located at North Pacific Avenue and Water Street.
cards.source_title: History | City of Santa Cruz, CA
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark at the North Pacific Avenue and Water Street junction.

cards.entity_name: Santa Cruz Public Libraries Downtown Branch
cards.title: Use a public-library stop
cards.subtitle: Church Street corridor — 224 Church Street
cards.notes: On the Church Street corridor, check the branch’s current hours and use its public library setting for reading, research, or a scheduled program.
cards.short_summary: The downtown branch of the Santa Cruz Public Libraries system.
cards.evidence_claim: Santa Cruz Public Libraries lists the Downtown branch at 224 Church Street and publishes its hours.
cards.source_title: Library Services - Santa Cruz Public Libraries
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Downtown branch hours and services; verify changes before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Santa Cruz Museum of Art & History
cards.title: See rotating art and history
cards.subtitle: Front Street corridor — 705 Front St
cards.notes: On the Front Street corridor, enter through Abbott Square or the main entrance and check the current exhibition and event listings before you go.
cards.short_summary: A downtown museum with rotating exhibitions and community programming.
cards.evidence_claim: The MAH identifies its downtown location at 705 Front Street and describes rotating art and Santa Cruz County history exhibitions.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists museum hours and suggested daily admission prices; special exhibitions or events can differ.

cards.title: Gather in the market hall
cards.subtitle: Front Street corridor — 725 Front Street
cards.notes: On the Front Street corridor, use the market as a daytime or evening food-stop option; check individual vendors for their own menus and availability.
cards.short_summary: A market destination at the Front and Cooper streets location.
cards.evidence_claim: Abbott Square Market lists its location at 725 Front Street and 118 Cooper Street, along with operating hours.
cards.source_title: Abbott Square Market - Abbott Square Contact
cards.access_notes: Market lists 8am–10pm Sunday–Thursday and 8am–11pm Friday–Saturday; vendor schedules may vary.

cards.title: Explore Monterey Bay science
cards.subtitle: Pacific Avenue corridor — 35 Pacific Avenue
cards.notes: At the south end of the Pacific Avenue corridor, work through the interactive marine exhibits and short films during the center’s listed public hours.
cards.short_summary: NOAA’s interactive visitor center for Monterey Bay marine ecosystems.
cards.evidence_claim: NOAA states that the Sanctuary Exploration Center at 35 Pacific Avenue has interactive exhibits, programs, and free admission.
cards.access_notes: NOAA lists free admission, Wednesday–Sunday hours of 10am–4pm, and limited nearby metered parking.

cards.title: Walk the municipal wharf
cards.subtitle: Beach Street corridor — Santa Cruz Wharf
cards.notes: From the Beach Street corridor, walk the wharf for bay views and wildlife watching; use the official public-hours listing and observe posted conditions.
cards.short_summary: A public wharf extending more than a half mile into Monterey Bay.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Santa Cruz County states that the Santa Cruz Wharf extends over a half mile into the sanctuary and is open daily to the public.
cards.source_title: Santa Cruz Wharf - Visit Santa Cruz County
cards.access_notes: Official visitor source lists public hours of 5am–2am daily; follow current posted wharf rules and closures.

cards.title: Find the historic rides
cards.subtitle: Beach Street corridor — 400 Beach Street
cards.notes: Along Beach Street, use the Boardwalk’s official map and hours to plan a visit; decide in advance whether you want rides, games, or only the promenade.
cards.short_summary: A California historical landmark with the Giant Dipper and Looff Carousel.
cards.evidence_claim: California State Parks lists the Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk at 400 Beach Street and documents its 1911 carousel and 1924 Giant Dipper.
cards.source_title: Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk | California State Parks
cards.access_notes: The Boardwalk confirms its 400 Beach Street location; parking is separately charged and ride access varies by ticket option.

cards.title: Follow the history wall
cards.subtitle: River Street corridor — 1010–1070 River Street
cards.notes: On the River Street corridor, look for the outdoor History Wall and preserved tannery buildings; check individual studio or gallery schedules before visiting indoors.
cards.short_summary: An adaptive-reuse arts campus in historic tannery buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tannery Arts Center documents preserved mid-1800s buildings and an outdoor History Wall with murals and a timeline.
cards.access_notes: The center lists its campus at 1010–1070 River Street; public access and hours vary by studio, gallery, class, and event.

cards.title: Check the performance calendar
cards.subtitle: River Street corridor — 1010 River Street
cards.notes: At the Tannery’s River Street corridor, check the theater calendar before heading over and arrive with enough time to find the venue within the arts campus.
cards.short_summary: A theater inside the Tannery Arts Center campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Colligan Theater identifies itself as part of the Tannery Arts Center and lists its address at 1010 River Street.
cards.source_title: Contact | Get in Touch Today — The Colligan Theater
cards.access_notes: Event availability and ticket requirements depend on the specific performance; consult the theater directly.
